digest.component_or_area: agent task harness and process lifecycle management
propositions: Subagents spawn unbounded CPU saturation workers (python -c 'while True: pass') without enforcing wall-clock time limits at spawn, causing them to orphan to PID 1 and consume resources for days after the parent exits.

The 38 leaked workers observed on 2026-08-22 ran continuously for four days at ~1341% combined CPU and load average 58.49, making the workstation unusable and rendering timing-sensitive test results unreliable.

Detection of orphaned high-CPU processes is needed to identify already-leaked batches; the system must distinguish legitimate system daemons (PPID 1 is normal on macOS) from genuinely orphaned user-spawned helpers via path-based filtering.

Agent guidance must mandate bounded background processes (timeout at spawn), process-group teardown (trap EXIT), and reaping on all exit paths to prevent PPID 1 orphans from outliving investigation sessions.
